prompt: What lets the team drop the low-platform requirement?
promptZh: 為什麼這次可以不必使用矮平台？

options.text: The taller case will be replaced.
options.whyZh: 男方最後說照原計畫使用高展示櫃。

options.text: The bell will be placed outside the case.
options.zh: 青銅鐘會放在展示櫃外面。
options.whyZh: 仍要挑選能進展示櫃的展架。

options.text: The bell can hold its own label.
options.zh: 青銅鐘本身可托住標籤。
options.whyZh: 對話交代標籤貼到牆上，不是放在鐘上。

options.text: The label can be mounted separately.
options.whyZh: 把標籤放到牆上，就不必用矮平台支撐。

explanationZh: 把標籤放到牆上，就不必用矮平台支撐。
evidence: The case door is only forty centimetres wide, so the whole stand must fit through it. The shelf must not be narrower than the bell. Do we still need a low platform for the label? | No. The label can go on the wall. Please use the stand chart to choose what fits, then check that the felt pads are in the drawer.
